summary: REGRESSION certification of RideChoosePage refactor (RideVehicleSection.jsx + RideModePanels.jsx extraction). Full taxi flow re-tested end-to-end as famtester@demo.sb. ALL 5 critical refactor surfaces work correctly: vehicle list renders with prices, vehicle info modal opens with price grid + closes on Choisir, payment dropdown opens with all 4 options + wallet-ok-notice shows on Portefeuille, schedule panel renders on step 1, and ride creation CTA proceeds to /ride/{id} with 'Recherche d’un chauffeur...' UI and NO errors. The pure extraction introduced NO regression. Pickup auto-defaults to Fort-de-France (expected per env note). 11 vehicle cards rendered with sane local prices (7.15 € – 25.00 €).

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not introduced by this refactor): Google Maps JS prints multiple deprecation warnings every load — google.maps.places.Autocomplete (use PlaceAutocompleteElement), google.maps.Marker (use AdvancedMarkerElement), google.maps.DirectionsService and DirectionsRenderer (use google.maps.routes.Route.computeRoutes). These will eventually need migration but are non-blocking for now.
Pre-existing (not introduced by this refactor): noisy WebSocket warning 'wss://.../api/ws/user_xxx is closed before the connection is established' on /course load. Cosmetic.
Pre-existing (not introduced by this refactor): two 401s logged at the very start of the session before the auth token is applied. Cosmetic.

Spec language mismatch: requirement says '.leaflet-container' but the actual /course step-2 map is a Google Map (gm-style div). Either update the spec wording or migrate /course to Leaflet for consistency with other map views in the app.

RideChoosePage.js is now 967 lines — still above the 700-line guideline. The refactor was good (extracted ~250 lines into taxihub/) but consider splitting the remaining orchestrator into smaller hooks (e.g., useRideEstimate, useRideRequest, useRideMode) on a future pass.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 5 required refactor surfaces (vehicle list + info modal + payment dropdown + ride CTA + mode panels)

context_for_next_testing_agent: RideChoosePage refactor is CERTIFIED no-regression. Flow: /login/email -> /course -> pickup auto-fills 'Fort-de-France, Martinique' -> type 'Schoelcher Martinique' in destination input (placeholder 'Où allez-vous ?') -> wait 2.5s -> click first .pac-item -> auto-advances to map+vehicle step (do NOT look for continue-to-map-btn at that point) -> vehicle list, info modal, payment dropdown, CTA all work -> CTA navigates to /ride/{id}. To test other mode panels (panel-flight, panel-rental, panel-buddy, panel-pets, panel-assist), enter via a service catalog tile that exposes the multi-mode grid (e.g., /taxi -> specific mode).
rca of the issue: No bug found. The one item that initially looked like a failure (continue-to-map-btn NOT FOUND) is actually correct behavior: when the user picks a Google Places autocomplete suggestion, the app auto-advances to step 2 (showMap=true), so the continue button is intentionally no longer in DOM. The map + vehicle list + payment + CTA all render correctly on step 2 — verified visually and by data-testid.
